name: Turso Free
free_limit: Free: 100 databases, 5 GB total storage, 500M rows read and 10M rows written/month, plus 3 GB monthly sync
watch_out: Turso's $0 Free plan has no credit card requirement, but reads, writes, storage and embedded sync each have independent limits. Free has 1-day audit log retention; point-in-time restore and deleted database recovery are paid-plan features. Avoid treating 3 GB sync as unlimited network traffic.
